topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor approached me about using a portion of my yard for a garden, I listened quietly. It’s not that I mind the idea of someone cultivating something, but the request hung in the air between us, heavy with implications. I nodded slowly, considering the boundaries of my space and how they might shift. In the end, I gave a measured response, outlining the conditions and ensuring that both our needs would be met without one encroaching on the other. It’s a delicate balance, this sharing, but it seemed like the right thing to do.
